features.name: Nudge bar

features.name: Position multipliers
features.description: Fixed multipliers that add together inside a win.

review:
Street racing on 5x4, with a Nitro Mode that can kick in on any spin. When it does, at least five nudges load into a bar, five special symbols drop onto the grid, and up to three position multipliers appear.

Once wins are paid, the nudges fire one at a time: every symbol drops a row and new ones fall in, while the multipliers stay put and fresh symbols slide over them. Multipliers in one win add together. A neat twist on cascades. Rated high, 15,000x max, top RTP 96.31%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.26% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
